stories.title: Christa Pike bij bewustzijn en aanspreekbaar na mislukte executie

en.title: Christa Pike conscious and able to speak after failed execution
en.summary: A Tennessee inmate who underwent a failed execution last week has regained consciousness and can communicate, according to her lawyers. Despite serious arm injuries, she remains shackled to a hospital bed while receiving intensive medical care.

stories.title: Christa Pike is weer bij bewustzijn en aanspreekbaar na mislukte executie in VS

en.title: Christa Pike conscious and able to speak after failed execution in US
en.summary: Christa Pike has regained consciousness following a failed execution in the United States last week and is now able to communicate, her lawyers report.

stories.title: Het kabinet-Jetten krijgt het moeilijk in de Eerste Kamer, maar Pro en VVD vinden elkaar daar wél

en.title: Jetten cabinet faces difficulties in Senate, but Pro and VVD find common ground
en.summary: Premier Jetten defended his government's plans before a skeptical Senate on Tuesday. Multiple parties are making demands before approving the budget, creating challenges for passage.

stories.title: Studenten Cornell woedend om verkrachtingszaak: 'Universiteit bang voor reputatie'

en.title: Cornell students angry over rape case: 'University afraid for reputation'
en.summary: Protests at Cornell University have grown following allegations that a female student was raped two years ago. Seven fraternity members allegedly received minimal punishment from the university, though authorities are now investigating the case.

stories.title: Megafusie in Hollywood is een feit: Paramount neemt Warner Bros over voor 110 miljard dollar

en.title: Megamerger in Hollywood is a fact: Paramount takes over Warner Bros for 110 billion dollars
en.summary: Paramount Skydance has completed its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery for 110 billion dollars, creating a major media conglomerate.

stories.title: Paramount rondt overname Warner Bros af in gigadeal van 111 miljard dollar

en.title: Paramount completes Warner Bros takeover in gigadeal of 111 billion dollars
en.summary: Paramount Skydance has finalized its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery for 111 billion dollars after more than a year, following a bidding war with Netflix that ended with the streaming service withdrawing.

stories.title: Franse scholieren zijn er klaar mee: 'Er is wel geld voor oorlog, niet voor ons'

en.title: French students have had enough: 'There is money for war, not for us'
en.summary: Tens of thousands of students, teachers, parents and union members demonstrated in Paris on Tuesday to protest education conditions, with police present in large numbers.

stories.title: Leerlingen uit banlieue en sjieke Parijse wijken betogen voor beter onderwijs: ‘De school van de republiek maakt zijn belofte niet waar’

en.title: Students from suburbs and wealthy Paris districts protest for better education: 'The school of the republic is not keeping its promise'
en.summary: A large demonstration in Paris on Tuesday brought together students, teachers, union members and parents to protest the state of French education, particularly outside the capital.

stories.title: Drie vakantieparken van Peter Gillis verkocht voor miljoenen

en.title: Three vacation parks of Peter Gillis sold for millions
en.summary: The forced auction sale of three vacation parks owned by Peter Gillis has been finalized after the creditor completed verification of bidders. The parks were auctioned due to Gillis owing over 27 million euros to businessman Marc van Rooi.

stories.title: EU-uitbreiding weer bespreekbaar, maar wel eerst proefperiode voor nieuwe landen

en.title: EU expansion back on agenda, but with trial period for new countries first
en.summary: EU enlargement, long considered taboo in Brussels, is becoming discussable again due to support growing since the Ukraine war and Trump's reelection. Concerns about costs and compliance from new members persist, but geopolitical pressures are shifting the debate.

stories.title: David Ellison breidt media-imperium uit: overname van Warner Bros. Discovery door Paramount officieel rond

en.title: David Ellison expands media empire: acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery by Paramount officially completed
en.summary: Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery under David Ellison's leadership has been officially finalized, expanding his media holdings.

stories.title: Financiële plannen kabinet sneuvelen mogelijk als in Eerste Kamer niets wijzigt

en.title: Government's financial plans may collapse if nothing changes in Senate
en.summary: Senate factions from PRO and BBB are demanding significant modifications to the tax plan in exchange for their support, mirroring their positions in the lower house. Without backing from either party, the financial plans face likely failure.
